input.explanation: The leak is entirely inside this repository: `io_shop.visits._LAST_SEEN` is a dict in the running process that gains an entry on every account-page render and never drops one. The patch caps that dict and evicts the least recently seen shoppers, so once it's deployed the process's memory stops climbing with every new shopper. Nothing outside the repo has to change. Callers (`account_page.record_visit`) use the same functions as before.
